job_dir.ask: Folder the SmartLab Studio II import flow takes job files from
job_dir.help: The folder the lab's Studio II flow template or Rigaku Automation Interface client watches (see references/rigaku_files.md). Must exist and be writable by the account running mhp on the Studio II PC.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the .rasx / .ras files of the queued scans are written
results_dir.help: The save location of the flow's General Measurement part; the package waits for <sample_id>_<token>.rasx (or .ras) there.

changer_positions.ask: Number of positions on the ASC sample changer (6, 8, 10 or 48)

changer_s.ask: Seconds a changer cycle plus alignment takes (for progress and the wait)

max_points.ask: Most data points a queued scan may have

max_scan_hours.ask: Longest scan an agent may queue (hours)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the results folder

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for a result before the job fails (seconds)
